temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say it has been tough and that she wonders if more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley cared for the patient and may be affected by the loss, but she does not yet know how deeply or whether Shirley feels responsible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Shirley's somber demeanor and her comment about wondering if more could have been done confirm deep grief and reveal self-questioning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply affected and possibly second-guessing their care; Sara believes they did everything they could and that Shirley needs comfort.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort and reassure Shirley, emphasizing the good care they provided and Sara's support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara raises the treatment decisions; Shirley says she feels responsible, wonders if pushing a different approach might have helped, and appreciates reassurance but says it is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and may feel some self-doubt about the patient's care, and she hopes to understand and lessen that burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Shirley's guilt is more explicit and specifically tied to treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels personally responsible for the outcome and is struggling to accept that responsibility was shared; she needs ongoing reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility, reinforce that decisions were made with available information, and offer shared support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara has observed Shirley remaining reserved and minimally expressive; when Sara confronts her, Shirley says she cannot be open because she fears seeming unprofessional or weak; Sara reassures her; Shirley says she may try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is still burdened and emotionally guarded, and that she may need encouragement to express her feelings.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Shirley's reserve is driven by fear of appearing unprofessional or weak rather than unwillingness to trust Sara.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley wants to be more open but needs reassurance that emotional expression is healthy and acceptable among friends.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her feelings and reassure her that showing emotion is not weakness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong; Shirley says it was a bit much but knows Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and wants to keep talking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and may have strained their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Shirley was somewhat overwhelmed, but she still values Sara's care and wants continued conversations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The friendship can be mended; Shirley appreciates the apology and open communication.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Mend the friendship, remain supportive, and continue respectful communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved; Shirley says she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support, and she agrees to weekend plans.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley values their talks and is recovering, but she may still need support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Shirley's improvement is confirmed, and her receptiveness to spending time outside work shows Sara's support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is doing better; continued supportive friendship and social time may help further.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley and plan to spend time together outside work.
